urls.title: Competitor page URLs
urls.description: One to 50 public HTTPS page URLs as strings. Duplicate URLs are captured once. The Actor does not crawl beyond the exact URLs you supply.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages to inspect
maxPages.description: Hard cap per run after deduplication. Successful captures count as results even if the text is unchanged.

includeText.title: Include captured source text
includeText.description: Include the captured page text in each output row (at most 24,000 characters). Saved baselines always keep the text in your own storage regardless of this setting.

previousResults.title: Earlier successful results (optional)
previousResults.description: Optional. Paste captured rows from an earlier run to compare against them instead of the saved baselines. Rows must be successful captures that include text, requestedUrl, url and capturedAt.

rememberBaselines.title: Remember pages between runs
rememberBaselines.description: Saves the latest successful capture of each URL in a private storage in your own Apify account, so the next run shows what changed with no copy-pasting. Turn off for a stateless run.

baselineStoreName.title: Baseline storage name
baselineStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store in your account that holds saved pages. Use a different name to keep separate watchlists. 3-63 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
